gaps.sentence: She's a leading ___ (SCIENCE) in climate research.
The report was highly ___ (CRITIC) of the new scheme.
gaps.explanation: 'Highly critical of' — the adjective describing a judgement.
'A brief introduction' — the noun from introduce.

gaps.sentence: The coach criticised the team's lack of ___ (DISCIPLINE).
gaps.explanation: 'Lack of discipline' — the noun is required after 'lack of'.

gaps.sentence: The results of the survey were highly ___ (SURPRISE).
It is ___ (DENY) that the policy has failed.
gaps.explanation: 'It is undeniable that …' — adjective meaning cannot be denied.

gaps.sentence: This shop offers a wide ___ (SELECT) of cheeses.
gaps.explanation: 'A selection of' = a range of items to choose from.

gaps.sentence: The test measures your ___ (STRONG) in each skill.
gaps.explanation: 'Strength' is the noun; 'strengthen' is the verb 'to make stronger'.
